thought.text: The 302 went to `/admin/bootstrap/select-claim` and stashed the verified claims. Let me fetch the claim-selection page:

reasoning_content: The first callback 302 redirected to `/admin/bootstrap/select-claim`. I need to follow that redirect (while preserving the admin session cookie) and fetch the select-claim page. The bootstrap claims have been saved in the DB draft. Let me try to fetch `/admin/bootstrap/select-claim` with the admin cookie — the select_claim_page renders from the draft.

action.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-bootstrap
curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt --max-time 10 "http://localhost:8080/admin/bootstrap/select-claim" -o selectclaim.html -w "select-claim: [%{http_code}]\n"
grep -o 'name="admin_group_claim_choice" value="[^"]*"' selectclaim.html
grep -o 'action="[^"]*"' selectclaim.html | head -1
grep -o 'name="_csrf_token" value="[^"]*"' selectclaim.html | head -1
